title: Updating Documents
subtitle: updateOne, updateMany, upsert, and update operators

content.text: MongoDB update operators like $set, $inc, and $push modify specific fields without replacing the whole document.
$set only modifies the specified fields; using {} without an operator replaces the entire document.

questions.question: Which operator adds 1 to a numeric field?
questions.explanation: $inc increments a numeric field by the given amount.

faq.q: How do I update all documents in a collection?
faq.a: Use updateMany({}, { $set: { field: value } }) — the empty filter {} matches all documents.
